column1: # ApplyLabelSpec.java spec for /C132E0278.fullbin (2026-11-03): globals of flash_erase() and the
# Freescale C90FL Standard Software Driver (SSD) it calls. The driver is called through a function-pointer
# table at 0x40002910 (SSD order: FlashInit, FlashErase, BlankCheck, FlashProgram, ProgramVerify, GetLock,
# SetLock; reached via the r13 small-data base 0x4000a8f8 - 0x8000 + offset). Every call takes the SSD_CONFIG
# struct at 0x400005e8. Lock indices: 0/1 shadow, 2/3 low primary/secondary, 4/5 mid, 6 high; passwords
# arguments/results shared by flash_erase / flash_unlock_sectors / flash_write.

column5: C90FL SSD FlashInit(pSSDConfig). Was flash_driver_init.
C90FL SSD FlashErase(pSSDConfig, shadowFlag, lowEnabledBlocks, midEnabledBlocks, highEnabledBlocks, CallBack).
C90FL SSD BlankCheck(pSSDConfig, dest, size, &failAddress, &failData, CallBack).
C90FL SSD FlashProgram(pSSDConfig, dest, size, source, CallBack). Points at flash_program_driver_c90fl.
C90FL SSD ProgramVerify(pSSDConfig, dest, size, source, &failAddress, &failData, &failSource, CallBack).
C90FL SSD GetLock(pSSDConfig, blkLockIndicator, &blkLockEnabled, &blkLockState).
C90FL SSD SetLock(pSSDConfig, blkLockIndicator, blkLockState, password).
SSD_CONFIG.c90flRegBase = FLASH_MCR register base; &flash_ssd_config is the pSSDConfig passed to every SSD call.
SSD_CONFIG.mainArrayBase: flash main array base address (blank-check ranges are offsets from it).
GetLock result blkLockState (bit set = block locked); written back without the target blocks via SetLock to unlock them.
GetLock result blkLockEnabled (lock register writable).
ProgramVerify failSource (source data at the first mismatch).
BlankCheck / ProgramVerify failData (flash contents at the first failure).
BlankCheck / ProgramVerify failAddress (first failing address).
flash_write: RAM source address of the data being programmed.
Bytes to program/verify (flash_write) or blank-check after erase (flash_erase); 0 = skip the erase.
Flash address to program/verify or to start the post-erase blank check.
FlashErase highEnabledBlocks mask (flash_erase arg 1); unlocked via lock index 6. Was flash_saved_sll_slms_mask.
FlashErase midEnabledBlocks mask (flash_erase arg 2); unlocked via lock indices 4/5. Was flash_saved_lml_hbl_hi_mask.
FlashErase lowEnabledBlocks mask (flash_erase seg): 4 = 48 KB @ +0x10000, 8 = 16 KB @ +0x1C000, 0x10 = 64 KB @ +0x20000; unlocked via lock indices 2/3. Was flash_saved_lml_hbl_lo_mask.
FlashErase shadowFlag (always 0 = main array).
